svg.title: Orbistry function call graph excerpt
svg.desc: 32 statically resolved caller and callee pairs. Up to two pairs for reviewed entry functions, then one cross-module pair per selected production module. This is an excerpt; all verified call sites are in call-edges.json and symbol-index.json.

g.text: Verified static call sites: function graph excerpt
Arrow: caller → callee. Open nodes for full callers/callees. Dynamic IPC and injected dispatch are excluded.
